AntaraX brand kit · guide 12 and the product sheets · version 1.4, 11 October 2026
Brand architecture

Keep each product’s style. Add the AntaraX layer.

Most AntaraX products are older than the AntaraX name. So every product keeps its own name, logo, colours and signature details, and every one is “by AntaraX”. AntaraX reaches into each product through the same small touchpoints, among them a little BaTech, used by its own rules, and one sign for AI.

Two layers in every product

The product stays itself. AntaraX adds a little.

The product layer stays

  • PLExyz GridForce field, shard and zone grid; zone colours; the multicolour wordmark; the hex-tile sign-in
  • JankaThe J that never closes; the ticks; its splash and thinking animations
  • AngkaThe sheet stack and its face; paper ground; plum and Lapis peach
  • TinaraPlum and gold; the kerawang window mark
  • AX FrameThe breathing cube halo
  • YaraThe A with riak, in teal

The AntaraX layer is added

  1. Credit line“by AntaraX” for every product, and “from REKA” on sign-in and reports.
  2. BaTech, quietlyThe signature motif in empty states; a Quiet band of the family’s corak on dividers, sign-in and email edges. By the BaTech rules.
  3. AI sparkleThe four-petal sparkle beside every piece of AI work: a forecast, a ranking, a draft.
  4. Thinking motionWhile AI works, the product’s own mark moves the AntaraX way: pieces drift out of step.
  5. Shared corePoppins, JetBrains Mono for numbers, shared status colours, AntaraX-blue focus ring.
  6. Intan eyebrowSection eyebrows start with the 9px diamond, in the product’s accent.
  7. App tileOne tile shape for every product, so they read as one family on a home screen.
  8. FooterThe legal line, and “Lapisan by AntaraX” wherever the API is mentioned.
The motif map

One motif per product, from its family

Every product takes one signature motif from its family’s BaTech niche, drawn in the family’s colour pair, as the BaTech guidelines require. The shape says what the product does; the colour says which family it is in. Meanings are BaTech’s own words.

YarariakOne tap, spreading.

PLExyz GridpetakSpaces in a real layout.

AX FrameintanOne world, seen many ways.

Loom (tenun, “the weave itself”) and Motion (bunga cengkih, “every vehicle, seen from above”) take theirs when their apps exist. Files: assets/products/<product>/<product>-motif.svg, assets/families/bands/<family>-quiet.svg.

Follows the BaTech guidelines

  • The official motif drawings, one outline weight, round caps.
  • The family pair for colour: never the product’s own colours.
  • Three strengths: Quiet (one light ink #C5CCF7), White on blue, Full colour (never behind text).
  • At least 24px on screen; above about 120px, two motifs or more.
  • Turn, never stretch. Motion slow and rare; stops for reduced motion.

BaTech in a product

A few quiet places, by the BaTech rules

The logo is always the hero, on a plain ground. BaTech appears once per screen: the family’s corak as a thin Quiet band (BaTech’s one light ink) along an edge, or the product’s signature motif in full colour as the picture in an empty state. The full cloth stays on antarax.ai.

The marks

Own marks stay as they are

Force fieldThe isometric cube boundary. Identical in every PLExyz product.
Core entityThe floating faceted obelisk. Identical in every PLExyz product.
Spatial contextThe only part that changes. Grid: a 2×2 zone grid. Flow: a path. Transit: a route. Crowd: scattered entities. Site: layers. Ward: rooms. Yard: lanes. Trace: tags and last-seen points.

Tinara

The kerawang window Choose one

What kerawang is

Ukiran kerawang is the pierced woodcarving set into Malay houses above windows and doors: a carved lattice that lets light and air through while screening the view.

Why it fits Tinara

The market is the lattice: thousands of companies, each one an opening. Tinara looks through it and finds the one worth calling, why, and how to open. The lit gold opening is the next company to call.

Window Recommended
Tinaraby AntaraX

An arched Malay window with its carved lattice, the top opening lit. The most specific to kerawang, and unlike any other mark in the portfolio.

Lattice
Tinaraby AntaraX

Nine solid diamonds forming one larger diamond, the top piece gold. The boldest at small sizes.

Trellis
Tinaraby AntaraX

A diamond lattice of lines, one cell gold. The lightest.

One mark, the name, “by AntaraX”

The credit is set text, never the A beside a product’s own mark.

CreditPoppins 500 at about 45% of the name’s size, in body colour. One line: a middle dot.
Clear spaceHalf the mark’s height on every side.
MinimumMark 24px (Grid 48px, then its solid variant). Under 120px wide, drop the credit.
